summary: Targeted retest of the pager rangeEnd bug from iteration_24 on Home/Learn (index.tsx). Reproduced the exact previous scenario: advanced demo@tradequest.app to currentUnitIndex=15 (revealedMax=25, totalPages=2) via POST /api/lessons/{id}/complete for l1-l45. Verified via Playwright on the web preview that the top pager label on page 2 now correctly shows 'LEVEL 21-26' (capped at revealedMax+1=26), NOT 'LEVEL 21-40'. The previously reported bug is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: Confirmed fix at index.tsx line 228: rangeEnd = Math.min(revealedMax + 1, safePage*PAGE_SIZE+PAGE_SIZE) -- page2 top pager (testID level-pager-top) now shows 'LEVEL 21-26' correctly, and only 6 unit headers (21-26) actually render in the DOM; levels 27+ are completely absent (no placeholder/number/lock icon).

pager-next is correctly disabled (aria-disabled=true) on page 2 since it's the last revealed page; bottom pager (level-pager-bottom) on page 2 shows no Next preview text (only the Prev-side 'LEVEL 1-20' label) -- confirmed no regression on this previously-passing behavior (line 434-438 guard 'safePage < totalPages - 1').
pager-prev / bottom-prev correctly navigate back to page 1, and page 1's label correctly reads 'LEVEL 1-20' both on initial load and after returning from page 2.

Minor test-environment note (not a bug): a streak-celebration overlay (testID streak-celebration) appears after login on first-daily-login and intercepts the first click on pager-next until it auto-dismisses (~2.6s) or is dismissed via backdrop tap -- expected app behavior, just required a wait/dismiss step in the test script.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only scope; used API only as test helper)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 retest scenarios passed: top pager label capped correctly, pager-next disabled with no bottom preview leak, prev navigation + page1 label regression-free)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily completed lessons l1-l45 for demo@tradequest.app via API to force currentUnitIndex=15 (2-page scenario), then restored the account directly in MongoDB to xp=0, level=1, level_current=0, completed_lessons=[], perfect_lessons=[], badges=[], daily_xp=0, streak=0, longest_streak=0 after testing -- no lasting seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The rangeEnd/pager-label bug from iteration_24 is confirmed fixed and verified. demo@tradequest.app is restored to Level 1/0 XP/no completed lessons. No further action needed on this specific item.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this iteration confirms the previously-identified RCA (rangeEnd using units.length instead of revealedMax) was correctly fixed by capping rangeEnd and the bottom pager's next-preview label at revealedMax+1.
